description.description: A human-readable description of the Amazon SNS channel.

topic.description: The Amazon SNS topic ARN that Nylas sends notifications to. Must start with `arn:aws:sns:`.

role_arn.description: The ARN of the IAM role that Nylas assumes to publish messages to the SNS topic. Must match `arn:aws:iam::<account-id>:role/<role-name>`.

notification_email_addresses.description: The email addresses that Nylas notifies if delivery to the Amazon SNS channel fails.

compressed_delivery.description: If `true`, Nylas gzip-compresses and then base64-encodes notification payloads before delivering them. Nylas adds a `content_encoding: gzip+base64` message attribute to the SNS message. To decode, base64-decode the message body, then gzip-decompress. Default is `false`.

trigger_types.description:
The event that triggers the notification. See the
[notification schemas](/docs/reference/notifications/) for details about each trigger
type.

See the [Grants](/docs/reference/api/manage-grants/), [Calendar](/docs/reference/api/calendar/),
[Events](/docs/reference/api/events/), and [Messages](/docs/reference/api/messages/) references
for information on how to trigger each event type.
